title.zh: Bitcoin ETFs Suffer Worst Loss Since June as Uptober Turns Red
title.en: Bitcoin ETFs Suffer Worst Loss Since June as Uptober Turns Red

current_state.zh: US spot Bitcoin ETFs posted their biggest one-day outflow since June 25 — $484.9M on Oct. 7, led by BlackRock's IBIT at $207.7M — as 30-year Treasury yields hit ~5.7% and oil neared $100, pressuring risk assets.
